verdict_reason: Titles match assertions and the tests mock only MdmClient, but the capturing metrics writer set-up is another copy of set-up already repeated across the metrics tests.

todos.issue: setUp builds a capturing LookupMetrics as new LookupMetrics(new EmfMetricWriter(true, "trade-imports-reference-data", () -> new MetricsLogger(metricsEnvironment))), copying LookupMetricsTest:13-15. The same capturing-writer construction is also repeated in EmfMetricWriterTest, CacheMetricsTest and DependencyAvailabilityMetricsTest, so this adds another copy of set-up shared between tests
todos.fix: Must: one shared test helper (for example beside CapturingEmfEnvironment in the metrics test package) builds an enabled EmfMetricWriter over a CapturingEmfEnvironment, and CommoditiesControllerTest and LookupMetricsTest call it with no local copies. One way: a static CapturingEmfEnvironment.writer() or a CapturingMetrics test fixture returning the writer and its captured documents
